root.text: Greetings, hero! Welcome to the Spielburg Guild Hall. How may I assist your hero's journey today?

options.text: How do I become a Paladin?
Where can I train my combat skills?

ask_who.text: I am Guildmaster Bruno, veteran warrior of Spielburg. I train brave adventurers in the art of swordplay, parrying, and honor.

ask_bounties.text: A raid of goblin spearmen stole the golden Sun Amulet of Spielburg! Their Chieftain commands a cavern camp in Mistvale Forest. Defeat him and return the Sun Amulet to earn 50 Gold!

ask_camp_location.text: Head east into Mistvale Forest. Follow the forest path until you reach the ancient Rune Sun Gate. Use the Sun Amulet to unlock the gate and enter the cavern!

ask_paladin.text: To unlock the Paladin Path, you must prove valor in battle and claim the Legendary Paladin Shield hidden in the Goblin Vault!

options.text: I will seek the Paladin Shield!

ask_skills.text: Step inside the Guild Hall and practice your sword strikes on the straw training dummy. You can also throw daggers at the target board in Town Square!

root.text: Welcome, seeker of the arcane. I am Zara the Sorceress. What magic or potions do you seek today?

options.text: Open Arcana Shop to Trade Goods
Where can I find new Spells?

ask_magic.text: Magic flows through the ancient ley lines of Spielburg. Wizards channel mana into elemental Flame Darts, telekinetic Fetch, and blinding Dazzle spells.

options.text: Where can I find new Spells?

ask_spells.text: I sell the Arcane Wizard Staff here at my shop. Furthermore, an ancient Scroll of Fetch lies hidden deep within the Wilderness Grove!

root.text: Halt, traveler! I am Sheriff Otto, Lawkeeper of Spielburg. Speak quickly—we have goblins threatening our borders!

options.text: Tell me about the Goblin Threat
Keep up the good work, Sheriff.

ask_goblin.text: The goblin raiders have set up a war camp in Whispering Cavern. Their Chieftain stole the Sun Amulet of Spielburg! The town council is paying top gold for any hero who recovers it.

options.text: I will defeat the Goblin Chieftain!

ask_notice.text: Inspect the Notice Board behind me for official bounties posted by the Town Sheriff and Guildmaster Bruno.

root.text: Fresh travel rations! Healing elixirs! Thief lockpicks! Welcome to Barnaby's General Market Stall!

ask_lockpicks.text: Shhh! Looking for rogue tools? I sell authentic Thief Lockpicks—very useful for picking locks on treasure chests!
